items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: first band we organized was Lawrence on banjo, Adam Morrell on the bass, which is Lawrence's brother, cousin of mine.

ctx.x: Did you...when you took up drums, did you have any lessons? Did your father help you or any...

No, no, no one learned how to play the drums. And in later years, in later years when I was...first band we organized was Lawrence on banjo, Adam Morrell on the bass, which is Lawrence's brother, cousin of mine. He's still living.
You see the one that's still living?

items.title: Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1959-01-02
items.q: when I put up my own band with Bush Hall's name, Paul Barnes, my brother, Edward Moreira, bass violin, and my cousin Josiah Frazier on drums.

ctx.x: But your brother John is the one that taught you? Yeah, my brother John. Did he just teach you by ear at first or did he try to teach you to read by the way? Well, no, he teach me by ear.

Mm-hmm. He teach me by ear. That's how I learned first. But I learned music long, long years after when I put up my own band with Bush Hall's name, Paul Barnes, my brother, Edward Moreira, bass violin, and my cousin Josiah Frazier on drums.
Oh, while we're talking about that, how are you related to Paul Barnes and Emil Barnes, of course. They're cousins too, aren't they?

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: Eddie Morrell, which is my cousin, on the bass, Lawrence Morrell on the banjo, and I was on the drum.

ctx.x: And the Pack House that was located on the court had the restaurant and ball and pool table downstairs. They called it, they was run by this fella by the name of Faubacher. And this fella, Bebe, William Ridgely's brother, he was the manager of the place. I think I don't know, remember his name? His first name? Yeah, his first name was Bebe Ridgely, his first name, he was a big tall, brown skin, heavy built man. But he was the manager of that place there, I can't think of his first name. But all I can tell you,…
What's the name of that band?

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: Lawrence got the job and we made that Cincinnati trip.

ctx.x: Why'd you come to go to that Cincinnati thing with Lawrence?

Well, that was, the people wanted Lawrence up there. They knew Lawrence from George Lewis' band. Oh, yeah. The Rosenthal's family. Yeah. His name is, he's crazy about George Lawrence. Yeah. George Rosenthal. People out in Cincinnati. Lawrence got the job, did he? Lawrence got the job and we made that Cincinnati trip.
What was that band called? Hmm? What was it called?
